observation: All 327 source print labels identify volume 1. The title alone must not be taken as evidence of the whole three-volume translation.
required_handling: Label volume 1 web material; overall collection incomplete and volume-level completeness unverified.

observation: Large top article title and smaller body heading need not be identical. Chapter-level notes can occur before the print-page marker.
required_handling: Preserve both titles, and store heading notes separately without treating them as narration.

observation: P.x-y labels belong to the topic section and are not exact page boundaries for individual narrations; body records are not numbered in sampled pages.
required_handling: Separate actual PDF pages from inherited section print-page range; canonical/printed hadith numbers null unless verified.

observation: PDF470 prints 1巻 P.550-551 between P.463-470 and P.471-475. The print order anomaly is visually confirmed.
required_handling: Retain PDF source order, preserve original range, flag; do not silently move or renumber.

observation: Other programmatic print-label anomalies: PDF37 P.55 then PDF38 P.54-55; PDF178 P.184-185 then PDF180 P.187; PDF267 P.258-259 then PDF268 P.261. These may reflect source organization or book-title pages, not necessarily missing hadiths.
required_handling: Preserve raw labels and record uncertainty; no automatic missing-narration claim.

observation: Visible source defects include み使いはは and 週末 on PDF8, and み傾い on PDF576.
required_handling: Preserve source text verbatim; any optional correction must be a distinct editorial field with evidence.

observation: Embedded Arabic includes presentation forms and multiword runs whose extracted token sequence follows visual positioning rather than logical Arabic order. 21 lines / 249 Arabic-block characters found including presentation forms.
required_handling: Keep raw evidence; flag logical-order/character review and do not populate a complete Arabic-original field from these snippets.

observation: The displayed quoted phrase contains ماع, corresponding to extracted ﻣﺎع, beside Latin ma'in.
required_handling: Do not silently replace it with canonical Quran text; preserve source and mark possible source defect.

observation: Narrator headers, nested speech, standalone transmission variants and commentary share normal body font and can look similar. Route notices may consist only of a statement that the same report was transmitted.
required_handling: Avoid treating every は言った/伝えている line as a new narration. Preserve separate variant occurrences where source boundaries are established; qualify inferred boundaries.

observation: Notes are interspersed in flow after narrations, may have several paragraphs, and may be numbered or unnumbered; some title notes precede the source range.
required_handling: Store full note texts and links distinctly; do not put commentary inside prophetic text.

observation: Three human translators and division of work are documented, but individual narration-to-translator attribution is not printed.
required_handling: Record all three credits with exact source scopes; leave per-occurrence translator null unless separately established.
